{{Top|leg}}
The slang term '''mongrel''' was used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to identify a [[Cloning/Legends|non-clone]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had a leadership role during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A mongrel usually took direct command of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] unlike a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who typically gave orders to the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] to relay to the troops.<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
